topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I was scrolling through my phone, taking a break from my latest sketch, when I stumbled upon an image that made me do a double-take. There, on someone’s arm, was a piece of art that looked eerily familiar. It was one of my original pieces, the intricate lines and unique details unmistakable. The person who had it inked onto their skin hadn’t even reached out for permission. My eyes widened as I absorbed the sight, a mix of thoughts swirling in my head. Was it flattering? Maybe. But the unexpected discovery left me pondering the boundaries of my creations in a world where digital sharing can lead to real-world surprises.
